skill.summary: 基于恒生聚源 MCP 金融数据库生成专业级晨会精华纪要。触发场景：用户要求"晨会总结"、"研报汇总"、"市场观点"、"每日/周度纪要"、"券商观点"、"聚源研报"等。数据源限定为恒生聚源合作券商研报，严禁编造内容。Generate professional morning briefing summaries b...

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of the skill for generating professional-grade morning briefing summaries based on GilData MCP Financial Database.
- Supports multiple use cases including daily/weekly summaries, sector and stock-focused reports, and custom time ranges.
- Strictly sources data from partner broker research—fabrication or unverifiable content is prohibited.
- Ensures time sensitivity: uses only research published within user-specified or default recent periods.
- Outputs are highly structured in Markdown, including comparison tables for clarity and consistency.
- Guides users on environment setup; provides robust error handling and respects all compliance principles.
